components.name: ONNX-Runtime
components.distribution_role: Optional separately supplied C/C++ runtime linked by the native ONNX Runtime backend through PNMIR_ONNXRUNTIME_ROOT. No repository version pin exists. Record the actual release/version and retain its LICENSE and ThirdPartyNotices when distributing runtime libraries, header-derived code, or an environment containing them. The retained MIT text was verified at upstream commit 382e8a5747713a9d3bf3558b0f7bad2d4f6fe75d; that is a license-source snapshot, not a claim that this release is used.
